title: SMOK G-Priv Replacement Pods - 3 Pack
description: The G-Priv Pro pod mod delivers up to 80W max power from an external 18650 battery, as well as a range of advanced features, gorgeous ergonomic design and the high-performance G Priv Pod 2ml. The G-Priv Pod, with an e-liquid capacity of 2ml and a unique sliding top mechanism that slides the mouthpiece away to reveal the refill port, helping to prevent leaks. The G-Priv Pod is compatible with Smok’s LP2 coils which offer incredible flavour thanks to their mesh coil technology. As a sub-ohm device, the Smok G-Priv Pro is best suited to high-VG sub-ohm e-liquids.
